items.context: Could you specify the location linked to the disputed bill?
items.text: Main Paharganj, Delhi se phone kar raha hu ye payment sahi nahi lag raha

items.context: Are you saying the same month's charges are repeated?
items.text: Is bill me August mahine ka charge do baar hai kya ye galat hai?

items.context: Is there an issue with your account name details?
items.text: Main Ravi Kumar bol raha hu mera naam galat likha hai account me

items.context: Is the fine amount disputed or completely incorrect?
items.text: Yeh jo fine lagaya hai Dehradun branch ne wo galat hai
Main Anjali Verma Delhi se baat kar rahi hu mera outstanding amount galat dikh raha hai mujhe January mahine ka double charge laga hai
Namaste main Sunil Patil Mumbai se hu mera account number 987654321 me jo June ka bill hai wo mujhe sahi nahi lag raha please check karein
Mujhe lagta hai ki mere account me kuch extra charges add kar diye gaye hain main Padma Nagar se hu aur maine time pe payment kiya tha
Mera naam Rahul Mehta hai aur main New Delhi ka rehne wala hu mujhe lag raha hai ki is mahine ka outstanding charge sahi nahi hai mujhe confirm karna tha
Main Shruti Sharma Bangalore se hu aur mera account number 123456 me jo bhi amount dikh raha hai wo sahi nahi lagta kyunki maine pehle hi pura payment kiya tha
Main Deepak Joshi Jaipur se hu aur maine notice kiya ki mere account me kuch galat fees add hui hain mujhe pata karna hai ki ye sach hai ya nahi
Namaste main Rajesh Kumar hu aur mera bill Hyderabad branch se aaya jis me claimed charges galat hain please help mujhe ye confirm karna hai

items.context: Can you describe the issue with the current outstanding amount?
items.text: Mujhe aapke system me lag raha hai ki mera outstanding amount galat hai please mujhe bata sakte ho kya January ka charge double laga hai

items.context: Have you checked the charges related to your branch billing?
items.text: Maine apna bill closely dekha hai joh Noida branch se mila hai usme kuch charges inaccurately add kiye gaye hain kya aap help kar sakte hain?

items.context: Do you see any unusual charges on your account summary?
items.text: Kya aap confirm kar sakte hain ki mere account me extra charge Kyun aa gaya hai main Lucknow se baat kar raha hoon aur mujhe lagta hai yeh galat charge hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: dispute_amount - says the outstanding amount or a charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
